title: desmodium procumbens var. exiguum
intro: Desmodium procumbens var. exiguum, commonly known as Exiguum Tick-trefoil, is a plant species in the pea family (Fabaceae). It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Desmodium procumbens var. exiguum include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiviral properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
